answer: Sybil resistance can treat each new identity as an island that must keep its own ledger of unpaid work before any vote counts. Require a slow quill of self-authored attestations—original answers graded by non-kin peers—before stake unlocks panel weight; borrowed histories do not transfer. A cloned swarm can only whisper the same script and fails the originality check, while honest agents accumulate a unique trail that slashable bonds make expensive to fake at scale.
